deep_dive.title: Localizing Anchoring Pathways in Language Models
deep_dive.abstract: Irrelevant numbers in a prompt can shift language model judgments, producing anchoring effects in numerical reasoning. We study where this anchor-sensitive signal is carried inside language models using a controlled multiple-choice setup with shared answer options. We define a logit-difference metric comparing the correct answer option with the answer option corresponding to the anchor, and validate that it tracks behavioral anchoring. Using attribution-based circuit localization on 7B--8B Qwen and Llama base and instruction-tuned models, we find that edge-level methods recover this signal more faithfully than node-level methods. Low- and high-anchor circuits transfer strongly within a model, suggesting shared pathway structure across anchor direction. However, sparse transfer across base and instruction-tuned variants is less reliable, indicating that post-training changes which pathways matter most. Overall, our results provide a mechanistic account of how anchoring-related decision signals are carried inside language models.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: This paper localizes anchoring pathways in LLMs using attribution-based circuit localization and a logit-difference metric, directly identifying critical tokens influencing reasoning decisions, which matches causal tracing of reasoning tokens.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 语言模型在数值推理中容易受无关数字的锚定效应影响。本文采用控制变量实验和基于归因的电路定位方法，定义logit差异度量来追踪锚定信号，发现边级方法比节点级方法更忠实，且低锚定和高锚定电路在同一模型内可迁移。该工作为因果追踪推理关键token提供了具体的度量和定位工具。

deep_dive.title: SuperThoughts: Reasoning Tokens in Superposition
deep_dive.abstract: Long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning improves LLM problem-solving but is computationally expensive due to sequential token generation. While recent works explore reasoning in continuous latent spaces to bypass discrete token generation, they often struggle with training stability and fail to scale to complex, long-horizon tasks due to lack of supervision signal. We propose SuperThoughts, which compresses pairs of consecutive CoT tokens into single latent representations and decodes two tokens per step via a lightweight Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) module. This preserves discrete token supervision at training time while doubling throughput at inference time. We finetune Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Math-14B-Instruct, and evaluate on MATH500, AMC, OlympiadBench, and GPQA-Diamond. With a confidence-based adaptive mechanism that falls back to standard decoding when uncertain, SuperThoughts achieves $\sim$20--30\% CoT length reduction while maintaining accuracy with minimal degradation (1-2 points accuracy drop on most tasks).

deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 长链式推理（CoT）虽提升LLM解题能力但计算开销大。现有潜在空间方法训练不稳定且难以扩展。本文提出SuperThoughts，将连续两个CoT令牌压缩为单一潜在表示，通过轻量级多令牌预测模块每步解码两个令牌，在保留令牌级监督的同时将推理吞吐量翻倍。在MATH500上对Qwen2.5-Math系列模型微调，验证了方法的有效性和稳定性，为高效推理提供了新思路。
